description: The accessibility rules a consumer of Echo can still get wrong — names on controls, form errors, announcements, focus and target size — and, with a name, what that component's accessibility was actually tested against. Echo guarantees WCAG 2.2 AA; this is the part the guarantee cannot cover for you. It's for before building a form, a dialog or anything icon-only.

name.description: A component, for its own tested/untested record. Omit for the rules that apply everywhere.
